Died on 15 November 2012, eight days after admission.

Autistic looked-after child; St Andrew’s Healthcare
Prolonged seclusion and restrictive care; this is a living person’s case, not a death record.
The 2019 review found unmet needs, harmful restriction, weak safeguarding, poor regulatory follow-up and urgent actions with little impact.
NHS England conducted the review for the Secretary of State. It proposed coordinated planning, human-rights scrutiny, community provision and escalation.
